title: Designing a novel low-density, high-strength Al12Nb25.5Ta8.5Ti27.5Zr26.5 refractory high-entropy alloy for medium-temperature applications
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting using high-purity metal precursors (>99.9 %) in a high-purity argon atmosphere. Initially, a vacuum was created up to a level of 4 × 10−3 Pa, followed by argon backfill with a purity level of 99.99 %. A titanium getter was first melted to remove the residual oxygen from the chamber. The ingot was remelted 8–9 times and subjected to electromagnetic stirring to ensure chemical homogeneity.
